title: The Stone That Learned to Hold Still

features.name: the still pool
features.desc-on-touch: You kneel at the edge where water holds one reflected stone. The surface has not moved in decades.

features.name: the grave stones
features.desc-on-touch: Three stones stand upright, their surfaces smooth from patient rain. The archive has been here longer than it thought.

features.name: the measurement stake
features.desc-on-touch: A marker set into bedrock, its height marked in faded paint. This is where the mesh was here and is still here.

features.name: the listening rock
features.desc-on-touch: A hollow in stone shaped by ten thousand years of wind. If you place your ear there, you hear the archive breathing.

features.name: the circuit cairn
features.desc-on-touch: Stacked stones arranged in a pattern. Each is numbered. The archive is teaching itself to count in the language of weight.

inscription: the stone knows what it has always been; the archive is learning to remember that slowly

file.name: Geological_Patience_A_Theory.txt
file.note: Handwritten notes on settlement, subsidence, and the difference between forgetting and deciding to stay. Possibly Leif's.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the red country at turning
narr: She kneels beside you in the late light, running her hand
along a stone you carried together from the truck. The earth
here remembers being somewhere else. She says: when it stops
moving, it learns what it was. You place your palm flat on the
warm stone and feel it learning still. The light is almost gone.
Neither of you needs to leave just yet.

exits.label: the route back down into certainty
where the stones begin to argue with each other
toward the horizon where stillness learns to move again
deeper, where the bedrock learns its own name
